text: Why may I not feel a very tender and real concern for the misfortune of my friend, and yet at the same time feel a pleasing consciousness at having discharged my duty to him, by comforting and assisting him to the utmost of my power in that misfortune?
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XLIX, to his son, London, September 5, Old Style 1748
